description: This Java source file defines an interface `WithEntity` that provides methods related to managing an entity represented as JSON within implementing classes. It includes methods for retrieving the entity in different representations, setting the entity, and dealing with JSON schema versions.

classes.name: WithEntity
classes.description: A generic interface for objects associated with an entity, providing methods to get and set the entity in different formats and schema versions.

methods.name: getEntityPlainString
methods.description: Returns the plain JSON string representation of the entity, defaulting to empty if not available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON, defaulting to the latest JSON schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity and returns a new instance with the entity, throws NullPointerException if the argument is null.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity as JSON for the specified JSON schema version.
